notes.title: Free Prequel
notes.content:
Another free prequel!

Want to see what happened just before the events of Elemental Link?
Enjoy this new free game on Kongregate:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31940868/3b88c2285e1542a61bd27403e473234eadfdb8df.png[/img]
[url=https://www.kongregate.com/games/Beranek/tales-of-nebezem-gnomish-plot]Tales of Nebezem: Gnomish Plot[/url]

notes.title: Free extra content
notes.content:
Have a taste of the world of Nebezem in these short free games:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31940868/68c65871055ac5858b09b54840555597cd8f327a.png[/img]
[url=https://www.kongregate.com/games/Beranek/tales-of-nebezem-golden-scepter]Tales of Nebezem: Golden Scepter[/url] - a little Adventure game

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31940868/616ca742eef5cd9ece8b964bff3b448192e77db9.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.kongregate.com/games/Beranek/tales-of-nebezem-mind-trial]Tales of Nebezem: Mind Trial[/url] - a collection of puzzles

For those who have already completed Elemental Link, these two games provide some additional content. You can spend some time with Danu in the Western Kingdom and with Tyyni in the land of the air nation known as Miels.

Both games are connected to the main story of Elemental Link and they are both hosted on Kongregate.

notes.title: Now Available - Tales of Nebezem: Elemental Link
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the game has been released!

The gods of the four elements are awaiting your arrival in the world of Nebezem. 
Come and help them with their plan.
